briefing.text: Good day, sir. Workforce briefing for Helix Studio. Fourteen agents are on the roster: seven live, four in testing, and three blocked. Live: Lead Qualifier, Inbox Triage, Bookkeeper, Ads Analyst, Project Steward, Daily Brief, and 1 more. In testing: Follow up Writer, Complaint Handler, Cash Forecaster, Content Studio. Blocked: Deal Desk is waiting on Read access to the 2027 price book sheet; Invoice Chaser is waiting on Jordan approves the three reminder templates; Release Notes is waiting on Reconnect the Notion integration. That concludes the briefing.

greeting.text: Welcome back, sir. JARVIS online, and the workforce roster is loaded. Press Live and simply talk to me, or ask about any agent by name.

summary.text: Fourteen agents: seven live, four in testing, three blocked. Shall I go through the blocked items?

live.text: Seven agents are live: Lead Qualifier, Inbox Triage, Bookkeeper, Ads Analyst, Project Steward, Daily Brief, PR Reviewer.

testing.text: Four agents are in testing or shadow mode: Follow up Writer, Complaint Handler, Cash Forecaster, Content Studio.

blocked.text: Three agents are blocked. Deal Desk is waiting on Read access to the 2027 price book sheet; Invoice Chaser is waiting on Jordan approves the three reminder templates; Release Notes is waiting on Reconnect the Notion integration.

departments.text: The roster has six departments: Sales with three, Customer Support with two, Finance with three, Marketing with two, Operations with two, Engineering with two.

help.text: You can ask: give me the briefing; what is live; what is blocked; what is in testing; list the departments; or how is, followed by an agent's name.

unknown.text: I did not catch an agent or a topic in that, sir. Try: what is blocked, or name an agent.

bye.text: Very good, sir. I shall keep watch.

agent-lead-qualifier.text: Lead Qualifier, in Sales, is live. Live since March. Hand-off: Follow up Writer once a call is booked.

agent-follow-up-writer.text: Follow up Writer, in Sales, is in testing. Shadow mode: drafts land in reps' Drafts folders; 14 of the last 20 were sent unedited. Waiting on: 20 unedited sends in a row. Hand-off: Reps review and send every draft.

agent-deal-desk.text: Deal Desk, in Sales, is blocked. Built, but cannot read the new price book yet. Waiting on: Read access to the 2027 price book sheet. Hand-off: Jordan for discounts above 15%.

agent-inbox-triage.text: Inbox Triage, in Customer Support, is live. Live. Hand-off: Complaint Handler for anything upset or urgent.

agent-complaint-handler.text: Complaint Handler, in Customer Support, is in testing. Testing on last quarter's complaints before it sees live ones. Waiting on: Review of 30 historic cases by Sam. Hand-off: Sam decides every outcome.

agent-bookkeeper.text: Bookkeeper, in Finance, is live. Live in assisted mode: suppliers with three agreeing posts are coded automatically. Hand-off: Jordan for new suppliers.

agent-cash-forecaster.text: Cash Forecaster, in Finance, is in testing. Running in parallel with Jordan's spreadsheet for two weeks. Waiting on: Two matching weeks against the manual sheet. Hand-off: Jordan releases every payment.

agent-invoice-chaser.text: Invoice Chaser, in Finance, is blocked. Waiting on the reminder wording to be approved. Waiting on: Jordan approves the three reminder templates. Hand-off: Jordan sends.

agent-ads-analyst.text: Ads Analyst, in Marketing, is live. Live; the Monday brief lands in #marketing. Hand-off: Mia decides budget changes.

agent-content-studio.text: Content Studio, in Marketing, is in testing. Mia reviews every piece before it is published. Hand-off: Mia publishes.

agent-project-steward.text: Project Steward, in Operations, is live. Live. Hand-off: Sam for anything without a project owner.

agent-daily-brief.text: Daily Brief, in Operations, is live. Installed user wide, so it works in every Claude Code session.

agent-pr-reviewer.text: PR Reviewer, in Engineering, is live. Live on every repository. Hand-off: The author resolves each comment.

agent-release-notes.text: Release Notes, in Engineering, is blocked. The Notion integration was revoked during a workspace move. Waiting on: Reconnect the Notion integration. Hand-off: Mia edits before publishing.
